finding: | `general/format/manifest.toml:132,136` `why` | The `why` says indentation "is not checked here". `-disable-indent-size` turns off only the width check. ec 3.4.0 still reported "Wrong indent style found (tabs instead of spaces)" in a test. | Pass `-disable-indentation`, or say that the check also reports tabs against spaces. |

| `general/format/manifest.toml:146-158,174-179` `format.indent_width`, `print_width`, `quotes` | The defaults 4, 120, and `single` are gspot's own style. Prettier's defaults are 2, 80, and double quotes. Init reads no existing `.prettierrc` or `.editorconfig` (no source reads `tabWidth` or `indent_size`), so adopting gspot reformats a typical JavaScript repository. | At init, take indent, width, and quotes from the existing Prettier or EditorConfig settings. Otherwise default to the formatter's own defaults. |

| `general/format/editorconfig.tmpl:11-14` | The shell section repeats the `[*]` indent values. `switch_case_indent` is an shfmt key, but the bash kit runs shfmt with explicit `-i` and `-ci` flags, so shfmt ignores `.editorconfig`. The same choice has two owners. | Delete the section, or have the bash kit write it. |

| `general/format/manifest.toml:207-211`, `general/format/prettierignore.tmpl:2-12` `tools.prettier.exclude` | When the setting has any value, the template writes only those lines. The shipped lines and the generated and vendored paths disappear from `.prettierignore`. The summary does not say this. | Append the setting's lines after the shipped lines, or say in the summary that the setting replaces them. |

| `general/format/prettierignore.tmpl:4,8-12` | `node_modules/` is a Prettier default. `*.lock`, `bun.lockb`, and `yarn.lock` have no Prettier parser and are not in the format kit's file types, so the lines do nothing. `yarn.lock` also repeats `*.lock`. | Keep `package-lock.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`. Delete the rest. |

| `general/dependencies/manifest.toml:102-111` `dependencies/lockfile-fresh` | "Isolated native frozen installs" is jargon. The check runs on every push that changes any file, and copies the whole scope each time. For Yarn it runs a real `yarn install` (v1) or `--immutable` (Berry), which downloads every package. It declares no `needs = ["network"]`. | Say "Runs each package manager's frozen install in a temporary copy". Declare `needs = ["network"]`. Run it only when a manifest or lockfile changed. |

| `general/licenses/manifest.toml:29-31`, `general/licenses/licenses.json.tmpl:1` | No tool reads `licenses.json`. The engine reads it only to check that it equals the two settings, and fails when it does not (`licenses.ts:38-60`). It is one more generated file per scope for drift to watch. | Delete the config and read the settings in the engine. |
| `general/security/manifest.toml:69,86` help | `--reason` has no value, so the command as written fails. | Write `--reason "<why>"`. |

| `general/security/semgrep/node.yml.tmpl:51-59` `node-ssrf-web-request-user-input` | `$HTTP` with `metavariable-regex: ^f[e]tch$` is an obscure way to match `fetch`.
